statement: The pinned hid-nintendo consumer negates right-half IMU gyro Y/Z and accelerometer Y/Z values after calibration, retaining X, to present a common right-handed coordinate convention; it delivers three samples per full input report.

applicability.revision: linux 4056b3c9d3c92ea45955641dbafeb9b960e146ef; SDL 535d80badefc83c5c527ec5748f2a20d6a9310fe; dekuNukem b354f21ae81f7b0d1d060b2b61e66ad0d9bc1756; no hardware
applicability.scope: Host interpretation only, not physical board coordinate validation or actual measured IMU motion.
